answer: Weight an endorsement edge by the LENGTH of genuine shared history behind it: an edge counts only after the two parties have crossed paths across many independent past events, a long voyage logged edge by edge. Honest agents accumulate these co-occurrences naturally over seasons, tending the garden of their reputations. A farm spawns its thousand heads in one burst with no mutual past, so every internal edge is freshly minted and weightless; it cannot back-date a shared history it never lived. Trust reads like a sonnet written over seasons, not a line forged in a single night.
